title: Repair Linux File Ownership and Permissions
objectives: Repair Linux File Ownership and Permissions
Verify the result through independent inspection and explain the observed state.

tasks.instruction: Open Terminal. Run ssh svc_ansible@ansible01, then cd ~/splunk-automation. Commands run inside the virtual environment.

inventory_notes.txt is owned by root and cannot be read by svc_ansible. Inspect ls -l inventory_notes.txt. Use sudo chown svc_ansible inventory_notes.txt and chmod 640 inventory_notes.txt. Read it as svc_ansible and verify the mode with stat.
